facts.subcategory: Boutique Hotel near Petra Visitor Center
facts.notes: Located approximately an 8-minute walk from Petra Visitor Centre. Buffet breakfast is available daily. Exact star classification, payment methods, and geographic coordinates are intentionally left unresolved pending verification from official sources.

hotels.name: Valentine Inn
hotels.address: Alzohour Street, P.O. Box 205, Wadi Mousa, Petra 71811, Jordan

facts.notes: A free shuttle bus runs to the Petra Visitor Centre and back. Buffet breakfast is charged separately. Guests report that hot water is available during set morning and evening periods rather than continuously, and that air conditioning carries an additional charge of roughly JOD 3. A separate sister property trading under a similar name also operates in Wadi Musa.
Check-in is available from 09:00, which is earlier than most hotels in the town. Both smoking and non-smoking rooms are offered.

hotels.name: Ammarin Bedouin Camp
hotels.address: Beidha (Wadi Al Amti), Little Petra, Petra Archaeological Park, Wadi Musa 71810, Jordan

facts.notes: Owned by the Beidha Tourist and Archaeological Cooperative, recorded as 200 member families sharing revenue equally, and run by the Ammarin tribe. The camp deliberately provides no wireless internet and no air conditioning, though electricity for charging devices is available. Heating is provided in the communal Beit Shar tent in winter. A shuttle costs about JOD 10 per vehicle one way from the Petra Visitor Centre or JOD 13 from Wadi Musa, for up to four people. Towels are rented at about JOD 1 each. Nightly rates are not published.

meta.planning_lock:
PLANNING LOCK (hard — plan OVER clusters, then write JSON):
- Fill ALL 2 days (nights=1). No empty/partial days.
- Mandatory destinations (preferredRegions + mustVisit): Wadi Rum. Plan ONLY in these areas — any other cluster is reference material, not a day.
- Destination→cluster map: Wadi Rum→cluster 0 (Ma'an Governorate · culture)
- Day→cluster route (one day per cluster, in this order): D1:C0/Wadi Rum part 1 → D2:C1/Wadi Rum part 2
- mustVisit entity lock: (none)
- Each day draws its POIs, meals and hotel from ITS OWN cluster.
- No entity twice in the whole trip: a POI or restaurant used on one day cannot reappear on another, and lunch and dinner are different places. Two days in the same city are two different clusters — use each cluster's own entities.
- Each day: 3 sights + lunch + dinner (5 entries, 6 max). Two sights only when the cluster has no third worth visiting, and say so. No gap over 90 minutes, no site under 45 minutes, at least 4 hours of sightseeing per full day.
- activity_alternatives come from that cluster's UNUSED entities: never an entity scheduled elsewhere in the trip, and never two scheduled stops as each other's swap.
- One visit, one fee (POIs within 600 m are parts of one site): C0: Neolithic Village of Beidha + Little Petra (Siq al-Barid)
- Lodging requested: rating=, type=. Per-night base (night N = where day N ends): N1(C0): Petra Aretas Hotel [2-star]
- Money: 200 JOD covers 2 traveller(s) for 2 days (≈100 JOD/day for the whole party). Lodging = nightly rate x 1 night(s) x ~1 room(s), arithmetic shown in the notes. aiPriority= → keep picks proportionate to the stated budget. SME=(none).
- Entry fees are the last thing to cut: never skip a named destination's main ticketed site to save money, and state what is left of the budget.
- Names/hours/fees: EntityCards only. If a card does not carry a fact (rating, booking requirement, closing day), do not state it.
- Prices: use the card value as-is, multiplied by the party size, and show the arithmetic in the tip ("10 JOD x 4"). If a card has no price, estimate from pricing_level and label it "~N JOD (estimated)".
- Events are reference only: never schedule them in the itinerary or budget.

geographic.clustering_rule: Keep each day geographically coherent. Avoid unnecessary cross-country hops.

budget.guidance: Prefer modest dining and midscale stays. Do not invent prices.

climate.typical_pattern: High daytime heat, especially in the Jordan Valley and desert.
climate.outdoor_guidance: Walk outdoors in the morning. Keep the afternoon for shade, meals, or indoor visits.

decisions.title: Each exploring day stays in one area
decisions.why: Mixing far-apart cities in one day makes the trip exhausting.
decisions.effect: After arrival, the days run Wadi Rum (2 days).

decisions.title: Night one is near the airport
decisions.effect: Sleep in Amman on arrival night. The exploring days start the next morning.

decisions.title: Amman for the first night, then south
decisions.why: You land at Queen Alia, and the exploring days are in Southern Jordan.
decisions.effect: Stay in Amman on arrival night, then travel south the next day.

decisions.title: Sleep first — you still have a day
decisions.why: You land at 04:11, before the city is awake.
decisions.effect: Go to the hotel and rest properly. After breakfast, nearby visits fill the rest of the arrival day.

decisions.title: Then you move closer to the places you came for
decisions.why: Sleeping in the same city you visit beats a long commute every morning.
decisions.effect: After the arrival night, nearby days share one hotel. You only move when the next area is too far for a day trip.

decisions.title: Mornings for the outdoors
decisions.why: High daytime heat, especially in the Jordan Valley and desert.
decisions.effect: Walk heritage and nature in the morning. Save museums, meals, and shade for the afternoon.

decisions.title: A balanced pace
decisions.effect: On exploring days, plan on about 5 visits and 3 meals. Arrival follows the time left after food and rest.

decisions.title: A value budget
decisions.effect: Stays and meals stay modest. We only show a price when a listing has one.

decisions.title: Chosen around what you care about
decisions.effect: Stops follow culture. Unrelated places stay off the list.

decision_rules: Never invent POIs, hotels, restaurants, SMEs, prices, hours, or coordinates.
Use only retrieved catalog IDs. If a needed item is missing, leave it unknown and warn.
Must-visit destinations are hard constraints unless impossible.
Honor places_to_avoid as a hard exclusion.
Day 1 is the arrival phase, not an exploration day. Wizard duration is the exploring days after arrival.
Target about 5 sights and 3 meals per exploring day for a Balanced pace.
Recommend at most one tour guide and one tour operator for the whole package, not per day.
Tourist relevance always outranks commercial promotion.
Avoid stacking outdoor sites in peak afternoon heat.
assumptions: Travel times between cities are estimated qualitatively, not as exact minutes, unless evidence exists.
Opening hours are used only when present on the catalog record.
